#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
rng = random.Random(7)
directory = {}
for i in range(2048):
    directory["sip:user%d@host%d.test" % (i, i % 200)] = [
        "sip:alias%d@alias.test" % i, "tel:+1202555%05d" % i]
accounts = {"subj%d" % i: {"primary": "sip:user%d@host%d.test" % (i, i % 200),
                           "allow": ["sip:user%d@host%d.test" % ((i + 1) % 2048, ((i + 1) % 200))]}
            for i in range(2048)}
gateways = {"gw": {"local_domains": ["host%d.test" % i for i in range(200)],
                   "peers": {"p": ["host%d.test" % i for i in range(200)]}}}
body = "z" * 1500
raw = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\n"
       "From: <SIP:user1@HOST1.TEST.>;tag=q7\r\nTo: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\n"
       "Call-ID: sample-73\r\nCSeq: 0009 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n"
       "Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s" % (len(body), body))
jobs = [{"gateway": "gw", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "subj1"},
         "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw} for _ in range(2000)]
batch = {"directory": directory, "accounts": accounts, "gateways": gateways, "jobs": jobs}
data = json.dumps(batch).encode()
print("input bytes", len(data))
t = time.time()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"], input=data, capture_output=True)
print("exit", proc.returncode, "time %.2f" % (time.time() - t), "stdout", len(proc.stdout))
res = json.loads(proc.stdout)["results"]
print(len(res), res[0]["status"], proc.stderr[-500:])
PYEOF
